description: This Java class provides utility methods for handling Android manifest elements, including generating styleable names, retrieving static attributes and subtags, and checking required attributes.

classes.name: AndroidManifestUtils
classes.description: A utility class for processing Android manifest elements and related naming conventions.

methods.name: getStyleableNameForElement
methods.description: Returns the styleable name for a given manifest element if applicable.

methods.name: getStyleableNameByTagName
methods.description: Generates a styleable name based on a tag name string.

methods.name: getStaticallyDefinedAttrs
methods.description: Returns an array of attribute names statically defined for a given manifest element.

methods.name: getStaticallyDefinedSubtags
methods.description: Returns an array of subtag names statically defined for a given manifest element.

methods.name: getTagNameByStyleableName
methods.description: Converts a styleable name back to a tag name.

methods.name: isRequiredAttribute
methods.description: Determines if an attribute is required for a given element based on namespace and local name.
